name: Dropping to 0 Hit Points
summary: At 0 hit points, you fall unconscious unless a feature says otherwise. At the start of each of your turns, make a death saving throw. On 10 or higher, gain one success; on 9 or lower, gain one failure. Three successes stabilise you. Three failures kill you. A natural 20 restores 1 hit point; a natural 1 causes two failures. Taking damage at 0 HP causes one failure, or two if the damage came from a critical hit.
